shared_elements: animals shown in profile with quadruped bodies
horizontal band of repeated motifs running across the top of the field
figures arranged in a single line facing one direction
justification: Both are shallow stone reliefs in which profile animals are set out in a line beneath a horizontal band of repeated small motifs, and both include a circular element within the field. Beyond that generic register logic they diverge sharply: A is a polished, smoothly modelled horizontal frieze with naturalistic human figures and a camel framed by neat rosette borders, while B is a rough, weathered vertical pillar bearing crude, flat, schematic creatures with no comparable framing or figural naturalism.
